actions.text: The EU's new AI framework is a welcome step toward safer, more transparent AI — especially for high-risk systems. For tech companies, it means investing earlier in risk management, independent audits, and clear documentation of training data and model performance. Compliance will be costly, but it also creates an opportunity: firms that bake in explainability, robust monitoring, and privacy-preserving techniques will gain user trust and a competitive edge. Policymakers should ensure the rules are proportionate and include support for smaller developers (e.g., standard compliance toolkits and phased timelines) so innovation isn’t stifled while accountability improves.
